title: Venezuelan Mushroom Empanadas with Indian Twist
description: A fusion of Venezuelan empanadas with an Indian twist, filled with sautéed mushrooms and spices.
instructions: In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of ghee over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start browning.
Add the garam masala, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the salt to taste and cook for another minute.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of the mushroom mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Brush the edges with ghee and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges with a fork to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops with ghee and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of chutney or salsa.
